valores.label: June, mean monthly flow at Birchbank, 1938–1967

fonte: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Water Survey of Canada, station 08NE049 Columbia River at Birchbank (monthly mean discharge, m³/s)
legenda: cfs: cubic feet of water passing each second.
texto_para_tela: JUNE ≈ 10× FEBRUARY · 1938–1967 / JUNE 216,620 CFS / FEBRUARY 20,832 CFS / BEFORE THE BIG STORAGE DAMS
credito_sugerido: Alpha Point calculation: Water Survey of Canada (station 08NE049). Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
nota: Refeito (conferir.py), igual ao dossiê (F029). São médias de 30 anos: a tela pode arredondar ('≈ 217,000' e '≈ 21,000 CFS') sem mudar o 10×; a forma é do redator. 1938–1967 termina antes de Keenleyside (1968) e Mica (1973).
